name: fort_lauderdale

known_heights_m._note: Published heights from The Skyscraper Center (CTBUH) city page skyscrapercenter.com/city/hallandale-beach (raw HTML read 2026-10-08; the public part lists four buildings, no floors). Position = the polygon centroid of the OSM footprint matched by name (osm_name). Not added: The Onyx Tower (112.8 m on the same page; no OSM footprint of that name in the bbox); Selene Oceanfront Residences W/E (99.5/97.4 m, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tallest_buildings_in_Fort_Lauderdale) and Jackson Tower (a Google-Earth estimate there): no OSM name to check the coordinates against; The Palms 1/2 (26.155 N) are north of the bbox. Hollywood beach has no published list (CTBUH 'Hollywood' is the inland Hard Rock).

The Beach Club Tower 2.osm_name: Beach Club II Tower II (OSM tag 83 m)

_bbox_note: Barrier-island beach strip from Hallandale Beach (25.972 N, the Miami-Dade line) through Hollywood beach to Fort Lauderdale beach (Las Olas to Sunrise Blvd); the inland Hollywood/Hallandale/Dania strip west of -80.128 and downtown Fort Lauderdale (-80.14) are outside.
_satellite_note: 2026-10-08 (Esri identify, free): World Imagery = Broward County Orthos 2024-01-29, 15 cm, aerial (county orthos: little or no lean, shadows only, as Miami) at all three beaches; Wayback holds >= 8 scenes: UC-G 2010, Broward 6 in 2014/2015, Florida Orthos 2017-01/2017-12, Broward County Orthos 2019-01, 2020-12, 2024-01.
_pending_note: 2026-10-08: drone Photo Spheres confirmed by a one-image screen (free metadata scan of 5757 points within 2 km of the towers, 552 user spheres; 20 screened; OSM roads did not load, so the road-distance score term is flat). Not captured: a 2-row hi-res sphere (15 headings x pitches 8/-18 = 30 images, free allowance, ~$0.21 at list price) each needs approval. In order: Alexandre Pilot 2023-12, high over the Intracoastal 136 m from the Hallandale towers; 'Alexandre' 2023-12, high beside Hyde Beach House (90 m), Hallandale/Hollywood row along the Intracoastal; Alexandre Pilot 2024-01, low over the sea 225 m off the Beach Club towers; Christopher Frame 2022-06, high over the sea 180 m off the Diplomat, Hollywood row in view; Felix Mizioznikov 2022-08, high over the Intracoastal 384 m, Hollywood beach towers; Rick Goldman 2022-10, low over the sea 272 m off Hollywood beach. Also drones: Alexandre Pilot 2024-01 25.988,-80.1099 (802 m, low over the sea), Rick Goldman 2022-06 26.00648,-80.11533 (dusk) and 2021-06 26.00795,-80.12119 (faces west). None confirmed at Fort Lauderdale beach itself: the high scorers there are underwater (Westin Shenkman 2026-08), a yacht (Lenny Kagan) or boats.
_truth_note: Survey-only truth, single source (2026-10-08): no Google 3D Tiles cross-check (monthly cap). Read from USGS_LPC_FL_Southeast_B1_2018_LAS_2019 (Broward, GPS-dated 2018-06-02), the only 3DEP project here; towers finished after mid-2018 read as construction or ground. 140 footprints in runs/benchmark/truth/fort_lauderdale.json: only the 6 tallest of 89 strip tiles were read in the time box (Hallandale Beach Club / Hyde, the Diplomat block, Trump Hollywood); Fort Lauderdale beach is still unread. Published vs survey: Beach Club 1/2/3 read 134.5/151.0/133.8 m (published 134.1/153.9/134.1; OSM tags Tower 2 at 83 m, wrongly).
